records.jp: あ、やっと来た！　おーそーいーよー！
records.en_original: Oh, there you are! Took you long enough!
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, there you are! Took you long enough!
records.en: Oh, there you are! Took you long enough!

records.jp: ごめん……
records.en_original: Sorry...
records.en_auxiliary: Sorry...
records.en: Sorry...

records.jp: あの、さ……
records.en_original: Um, so...
records.en_auxiliary: Um, so...
records.en: Um, so...

records.jp: 気持ちよかった？
records.en_original: It felt good, didn't it?
records.en_auxiliary: It felt good, didn't it?
records.en: It felt good, didn't it?

records.jp: え？
records.en_original: Sorry?
records.en_auxiliary: Sorry?
records.en: Sorry?

records.jp: 思いっきり動けて！
records.en_original: To be able to move so freely!
records.en_auxiliary: To be able to move so freely!
records.en: To be able to move so freely!

records.jp: リフレクターって、すごいでしょ？
records.en_original: Isn't being a Reflector great?
records.en_auxiliary: Isn't being a Reflector great?
records.en: Isn't being a Reflector great?

records.jp: リフレクターって……今朝の！
records.en_original: Reflector... Wait, how do you--...
records.en_auxiliary: Reflector... Wait, how do you—
records.en: Reflector... Wait, how do you--...

records.jp: やっぱりあなたたち、何か知ってるの！？
records.en_original: What do you know about what happened this morning!?
records.en_auxiliary: What do you know about what happened this morning?
records.en: What do you know about what happened this morning!?

records.jp: アレは何！？　どこ！？　何が起きたの！？
records.en_original: What was that!! Where was that!? What happened!?
records.en_auxiliary: What was that?! Where was that?! What happened?!
records.en: What was that!! Where was that!? What happened!?

records.jp: あのバケモノは何っ！？<CR>どうして、私の足は動いたの！？
records.en_original: And what was that monster!? Why did my leg move!?
records.en_auxiliary: And what was that monster?! Why was my leg able to move like that?!
records.en: And what was that monster!? Why did my leg move!?

records.jp: はあ……
records.en_original: *sigh*...
records.en_auxiliary: *Sigh*
records.en: *sigh*...

records.jp: あなたたち、何を隠して――
records.en_original: What are you two hiding from--
records.en_auxiliary: What are you two hiding—
records.en: What are you two hiding from--

records.jp: あら、凛ちゃんじゃない。どうしたの……
records.en_original: Oh, hey, Rin. What's wrong...?
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, hey, Rin. What's wrong...?
records.en: Oh, hey, Rin-chan. What's wrong...?

records.jp: うん……
records.en_original: Oh...
records.en_auxiliary: Oh...
records.en: Oh...

records.jp: って、え？　ライム。それにユズと白井さんも。<CR>なんでこんなところに
records.en_original: Er, huh? Oh, Lime. And Yuzu and...Shirai. What are you all doing here?
records.en_auxiliary: Er, huh? Oh, Lime. And Yuzu and...Shirai. What are you all doing here?
records.en: Er, huh? Oh, Lime. And Yuzu and...Shirai-san. What are you all doing here?

records.jp: えっと、あなたは……？
records.en_original: Um, sorry, who were you again...?
records.en_auxiliary: Um, sorry, who were you again...?
records.en: Um, sorry, who were you again...?

records.jp: もうっ。同じクラスなんだからちゃんと覚えようよ！
records.en_original: Seriously? She's in the same class as we are, how do you not recognize her?
records.en_auxiliary: Seriously? She's in the same class as we are, how do you not recognize her?
records.en: Seriously? She's in the same class as we are, how do you not recognize her?

records.jp: まだ来たばかりなんだから仕方ないよ
records.en_original: Simmer down, Yuzu. It is her first day after all.
records.en_auxiliary: Don't give her a hard time, Yuzu. It is her first day, after all.
records.en: Simmer down, Yuzu. It is her first day after all.

records.jp: 真田凛だよ。同じ１－Ａで、部活はテニス部。よろしくね
records.en_original: I'm Rin Sanada. I'm also in Class 1-A, and I'm on the tennis team. Nice to meet you.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm Rin Sanada. I'm also in Class 1-A, and I'm on the tennis team. Nice to meet you.
records.en: I'm Sanada Rin. I'm also in Class 1-A, and I'm on the tennis team. Nice to meet you.

records.jp: ど、どうも……
records.en_original: L-Likewise...
records.en_auxiliary: N-nice to meet you, too.
records.en: L-Likewise...

records.jp: それでリンリン。暗い顔してどうしたの？
records.en_original: So, Rin-Rin. Why the long face?
records.en_auxiliary: So, Rin-Rin, why the long face?
records.en: So, Rin-Rin. Why the long face?

records.jp: い、いや。別にたいしたことじゃ――
records.en_original: Oh, no, it's nothing in particular...
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, no, it's nothing in particular...
records.en: Oh, no, it's nothing in particular...

records.jp: ずばり、恋の悩みね
records.en_original: Let me guess, you're lovesick?
records.en_auxiliary: Let me guess, you're lovesick?
records.en: Let me guess, you're lovesick?

records.jp: ！<CR>ななな、なんでわかるの！？
records.en_original: ! <CR>H-H-H-How did you know?!
records.en_auxiliary: H-how did you know?!
records.en: ! <CR>H-H-H-How did you know?!

records.jp: あ、当たった
records.en_original: It figures.
records.en_auxiliary: So I was right.
records.en: It figures.

records.jp: ライム……
records.en_original: Lime...
records.en_auxiliary: Lime...
records.en: Lime...

records.jp: だって、女子高生の悩みごとで一番多いのは恋バナでしょ？
records.en_original: Well, she is a high schooler. The chances that she's worried about love are relatively high, right?
records.en_auxiliary: Well, she is a high schooler. The chances that she's worried about love are relatively high, right?
records.en: Well, she is a high schooler. The chances that she's worried about love are relatively high, right?

records.jp: まあ、そうかもだけど
records.en_original: Yeah, but you don't have to be so blunt.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, but you don't have to be so blunt.
records.en: Yeah, but you don't have to be so blunt.

records.jp: うう……
records.en_original: Ugh...
records.en_auxiliary: Ugh...
records.en: Ugh...

records.jp: よかったら相談に乗るよ
records.en_original: If you want to talk about it, we're here to listen.
records.en_auxiliary: If you want to talk about it, we're here to listen.
records.en: If you want to talk about it, we're here to listen.

records.jp: ……内緒にしてくれる？
records.en_original: ...Will you keep it a secret?
records.en_auxiliary: ...Will you keep it a secret?
records.en: ...Will you keep it a secret?

records.jp: もちろん！<CR>ねっ？　ヒナちゃん
records.en_original: Of course! Right, Hina?
records.en_auxiliary: Of course! Right, Hina?
records.en: Of course! Right, Hina-chan?

records.jp: う、うん……
records.en_original: S-Sure...
records.en_auxiliary: Y-yeah...
records.en: S-Sure...

records.jp: それでそれで？　どういう感じなの？
records.en_original: So? Spill it!
records.en_auxiliary: So? Spill it!
records.en: So? Spill it!

records.jp: 実は……、中学の時から好きな先輩がいて。<CR>どうしたらいいか悩んでるの……
records.en_original: Well.. There's this upperclassman I've had a crush on since middle school, and I'm kind of at a loss...
records.en_auxiliary: Well... There's this upperclassman I've had a crush on since middle school, and I'm kind of at a loss...
records.en: Well.. There's this upperclassman I've had a crush on since middle school, and I'm kind of at a loss...

records.jp: へー。その先輩ってどんな人なの？
records.en_original: Ooh, I see. So, what's he like?
records.en_auxiliary: Ooh, I see. So, what's he like?
records.en: Ooh, I see. So, what's he like?

records.jp: テニス部のエースでキャプテンしてた人なの！<CR>地区大会でいつも優勝してて、都大会でもシードの選手なんだ
records.en_original: He's a tennis ace; the captain of the team! He always wins regionals, and is even a seeded player at the city level!
records.en_auxiliary: He's a tennis ace; the captain of the team! He always wins regionals, and is even a seeded player at the city level!
records.en: He's a tennis ace; the captain of the team! He always wins regionals, and is even a seeded player at the city level!

records.jp: すっご！<CR>超テニス強いじゃん
records.en_original: Whoa! He really is a tennis wunderkind!
records.en_auxiliary: Whoa! He really is good at tennis, then!
records.en: Whoa! He really is a tennis wunderkind!

records.jp: そうなの。それに勉強もできて、学年でもかなり上位だったんだ！<CR>高校もちょっと遠い進学校に行ったの
records.en_original: Yep. And he's smart, too--one of the brightest in his grade!
records.en_auxiliary: Yep. And he's smart, too—one of the brightest in his grade! He's even commuting to a prestigious high school.
records.en: Yep. And he's smart, too--one of the brightest in his grade!

records.jp: へぇ。じゃあ、最後に会ったのは中学の時？
records.en_original: Wow. So, the last you saw him was in middle school?
records.en_auxiliary: Wow. So, the last time you saw him was while he was in middle school?
records.en: Wow. So, the last you saw him was in middle school?

records.jp: ううん。たまに後輩を教えるために練習に来てたよ。<CR>その時に少しお話するくらいかな
records.en_original: Well, sometimes he comes here to practice or teach the younger students, so we chat a bit then.
records.en_auxiliary: Well, sometimes he came to our practices to teach the younger students, so we chatted a bit then.
records.en: Well, sometimes he comes here to practice or teach the younger students, so we chat a bit then.

records.jp: あと、たまにスマホで連絡してるよ
records.en_original: And, I sometimes text with him.
records.en_auxiliary: And, I sometimes text with him.
records.en: And, I sometimes text with him.

records.jp: たまに、なんだ？
records.en_original: Only sometimes?
records.en_auxiliary: Only sometimes?
records.en: Only sometimes?

records.jp: だって、先輩忙しいだろうし、あんまり頻繁に連絡したら<CR>迷惑かなって……
records.en_original: I mean, I'm sure he's busy, so if I try to talk to him all the time, it might annoy him...
records.en_auxiliary: I mean, I'm sure he's busy, so if I try to talk to him all the time, it might annoy him...
records.en: I mean, I'm sure he's busy, so if I try to talk to him all the time, it might annoy him...

records.jp: へえー
records.en_original: You think so?
records.en_auxiliary: You think so?
records.en: You think so?

records.jp: ……。それで、結局悩みは何なの？
records.en_original: ...So then, what exactly are you worried about?
records.en_auxiliary: ...So then, what exactly are you worried about?
records.en: ...So then, what exactly are you worried about?

records.jp: あの……、先輩にね、告白しようと思うの
records.en_original: Well, I... I'm thinking of telling him how I feel.
records.en_auxiliary: Well, I... I'm thinking of telling him how I feel.
records.en: Well, I... I'm thinking of telling him how I feel.

records.jp: おおー！　いいねいいね！<CR>それで？
records.en_original: Ooooh! Nice, nice! And??
records.en_auxiliary: Ooooh! Nice, nice! And??
records.en: Ooooh! Nice, nice! And??

records.jp: けど、どうやって伝えればいいか、わかんなくて……
records.en_original: I have no idea how to go about it.
records.en_auxiliary: But I have no idea how to go about it.
records.en: I have no idea how to go about it.

records.jp: 手紙とかは？
records.en_original: How about a love letter? It's a classic.
records.en_auxiliary: How about a love letter? It's a classic.
records.en: How about a love letter? It's a classic.

records.jp: うーん……。でも同じ学校じゃないし
records.en_original: Maybe... But we don't even go to the same school.
records.en_auxiliary: Maybe... But we don't even go to the same school.
records.en: Maybe... But we don't even go to the same school.

records.jp: 確かに、手渡しなら直接言うのと変わらないか。<CR>お家のポストに入れるのは？
records.en_original: True. If you can hand him a letter, you might as well tell him face-to-face...unless you leave it in his mailbox!
records.en_auxiliary: True. If you can hand him a letter, you might as well tell him face-to-face...unless you leave it in his mailbox!
records.en: True. If you can hand him a letter, you might as well tell him face-to-face...unless you leave it in his mailbox!

records.jp: ストーカーみたいじゃない……？<CR>郵送するのもなんかあれだし
records.en_original: Wouldn't leaving something at his house make me seem like a stalker? Mailing it seems kind of weird, too...
records.en_auxiliary: Wouldn't leaving something at his house make me seem like a stalker? Mailing it seems kind of weird, too...
records.en: Wouldn't leaving something at his house make me seem like a stalker? Mailing it seems kind of weird, too...

records.jp: 電話とかメールはどう？
records.en_original: What about confessing over the phone or via text?
records.en_auxiliary: What about confessing over the phone or via text?
records.en: What about confessing over the phone or via text?

records.jp: それは仲いい友達にも言われたんだけど、<CR>もし振られて、連絡しづらくなったら困るし……
records.en_original: My friends suggested that, too, but I feel like that'd make things awkward between us if he turns me down...
records.en_auxiliary: My friends suggested that, too, but I feel like that'd make things awkward between us if he turns me down...
records.en: My friends suggested that, too, but I feel like that'd make things awkward between us if he turns me down...

records.jp: 白井さんはどう思う？
records.en_original: What do you think, Shirai?
records.en_auxiliary: What do you think, Shirai?
records.en: What do you think, Shirai-san?

records.jp: え、私？
records.en_original: Huh? Me?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? Me?
records.en: Huh? Me?

records.jp: うん。何かないかなって思って
records.en_original: Yeah. What would you do in my shoes?
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. What would you do in my shoes?
records.en: Yeah. What would you do in my shoes?

records.jp: ……普通に直接言うのはだめなの？
records.en_original: ...I guess I'd just tell him when I saw him.
records.en_auxiliary: ...I guess I'd just tell him when I saw him.
records.en: ...I guess I'd just tell him when I saw him.

records.jp: だって、恥ずかしいんだもん。<CR>それに緊張してちゃんと話せそうにないよ……
records.en_original: But that's so embarrassing! And I'd be so nervous, I'm sure I'd end up saying the wrong thing...
records.en_auxiliary: But that's so embarrassing! And I'd be so nervous, I'm sure I'd end up saying the wrong thing...
records.en: But that's so embarrassing! And I'd be so nervous, I'm sure I'd end up saying the wrong thing...

records.jp: でも、そんなことばっかり言ってたら<CR>いつまで経っても告白なんてできないよ？
records.en_original: If you keep coming up with reasons not to confess your feelings to him, you'll never be able to do so.
records.en_auxiliary: If you keep coming up with reasons not to confess your feelings to him, you'll never be able to do so.
records.en: If you keep coming up with reasons not to confess your feelings to him, you'll never be able to do so.

records.jp: そんなのわかってるよ……。だから悩んでるんじゃん……
records.en_original: I know that, but... That's what makes this so hard...
records.en_auxiliary: I know that, but... That's what makes this so hard...
records.en: I know that, but... That's what makes this so hard...

records.jp: うう、どうしたらいいんだろう……
records.en_original: Ohh, what should I do...?
records.en_auxiliary: Ohh, what should I do...?
records.en: Ohh, what should I do...?

records.jp: 形はなんであれ、告白するべき。<CR>じゃなきゃ何も始まらない
records.en_original: No matter how you ultimately decide to do it, you should definitely tell him. Nothing will happen if you don't.
records.en_auxiliary: No matter how you ultimately decide to do it, you should definitely tell him. Nothing will happen if you don't.
records.en: No matter how you ultimately decide to do it, you should definitely tell him. Nothing will happen if you don't.

records.jp: わかってるんだけど、怖いんだもん
records.en_original: I know, but I'm scared!
records.en_auxiliary: I know, but I'm scared!
records.en: I know, but I'm scared!

records.jp: じゃあ、先輩から告白されるのを祈って何もしないの？
records.en_original: So you're just going to sit around hoping he'll someday confess his feelings to you?
records.en_auxiliary: So you're just going to sit around hoping he'll someday confess his feelings to you?
records.en: So you're just going to sit around hoping he'll someday confess his feelings to you?

records.jp: うう……
records.en_original: Urk...
records.en_auxiliary: Urk...
records.en: Urk...

records.jp: ヒナちゃんはどう思う？
records.en_original: Any thoughts on the matter, Hina?
records.en_auxiliary: Any thoughts on the matter, Hina?
records.en: Any thoughts on the matter, Hina-chan?

records.en_original: Huh...?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh...?
records.en: Huh...?

records.jp: どうしたらいいのかな……。私、どうしたら……
records.en_original: What should I do...? I just don't know...
records.en_auxiliary: What should I do...? I just don't know...
records.en: What should I do...? I just don't know...

records.jp: 告白される自信なんてないし、どうしよう……
records.en_original: He probably won't come to me, so how can I tell him how I really feel?
records.en_auxiliary: He probably won't come to me, so how can I tell him how I really feel?
records.en: He probably won't come to me, so how can I tell him how I really feel?

records.jp: 私、わかんない――
records.en_original: What can I do?
records.en_auxiliary: What can I do?
records.en: What can I do?

records.jp: そんなの知らないよ！<CR>二人の気持ちなんてわかんないし！
records.en_original: Ugh, who cares!? I don't know EITHER of you!
records.en_auxiliary: Leave me out of this! I don't know EITHER of you two!
records.en: Ugh, who cares!? I don't know EITHER of you!

records.jp: そういうのは自分でなんとかするしかない！<CR>他人に頼るのは間違ってる！
records.en_original: I don't know how you feel, so why do you expect me to figure out your relationships for you!?
records.en_auxiliary: You have to figure this kind of thing out for yourself! You can't just rely on other people to do it!
records.en: I don't know how you feel, so why do you expect me to figure out your relationships for you!?

records.jp: うう……
records.en_original: *sniffle*...
records.en_auxiliary: *sniffle*...
records.en: *sniffle*...

records.en_original: Oh...
records.en_auxiliary: Oh...
records.en: Oh...

records.jp: 私、私が……
……あの
records.en_original: ...Look, I didn't...
records.en_auxiliary: Look, I didn't...
records.en: ...Look, I didn't...

records.jp: 私が……。うわああああ
records.en_original: I... Waaaaah!
records.en_auxiliary: I... Waaaaah!
records.en: I... Waaaaah!

records.jp: これ、今朝の早苗と同じ……！
records.en_original: The same thing happened to Sanae this morning!
records.en_auxiliary: The same thing happened to Sanae this morning!
records.en: The same thing happened to Sanae this morning!

records.jp: まずい！<CR>暴走が始まった。急いで向かわないと
records.en_original: This is bad, she's starting to go rampant! We gotta move!
records.en_auxiliary: This is bad, she's starting to go rampant! We gotta move!
records.en: This is bad, she's starting to go rampant! We gotta move!

records.jp: 暴走……？
records.en_original: Rampant...?
records.en_auxiliary: Rampant...?
records.en: Rampant...?

records.jp: 説明は後！<CR>ヒナちゃん、急いで指輪をあの子にかざして！
records.en_original: We'll explain later! Just hurry and hold your ring up toward her!
records.en_auxiliary: We'll explain later! Just hurry and hold your ring up toward her!
records.en: We'll explain later!<CR>Hina-chan, hurry and hold your ring up toward her!

records.en_original: Huh...? My ring...?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh...? My ring...?
records.en: Huh...? My ring...?

records.jp: いいから早く！
records.en_original: Quickly!
records.en_auxiliary: Quickly!
records.en: Quickly!

records.jp: わ、わかった！
records.en_original: O-Okay!
records.en_auxiliary: O-okay!
records.en: O-Okay!
